name: DGHS / MoHFW HRIS Facility Registry — organisation list, Rajshahi Division
organization: Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
attribution: Source: DGHS Facility Registry (hris.mohfw.gov.bd), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Bangladesh
notes: Public report of the MoHFW HRIS Facility Registry (successor of facilityregistry.dghs.gov.bd, which returned 'Service Unavailable' on 2026-11-12). Excel export (ret=excel) of all active entries filtered to Rajshahi Division (division_id 3): 5,227 rows incl. government facilities, private hospitals/clinics/diagnostic centres, health offices and training institutes. Registry is live and self-reported by facilities; coordinates are as entered by facilities (QA flags in notes). Contacts kept only for non-private facilities (DGHS-issued office mobiles/landlines and dghs.gov.bd mailboxes); private/NGO contacts and facility-head names not collected. No licence stated on the site.
